events.title: Table-topping 번리 drop their first points of the season by drawing 3–3 with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 . Elsewhere in the top-flight, 입스위치 타운 rack up a fifth win in a row by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 4–1, 토트넘 홋스퍼 play out a goalless draw at 셰필드 웬즈데이 , 버밍엄 시티 put four without reply past 웨스트햄 유나이티드 , who slump into fifth, below both 입스위치 타운 and Spurs. In the rest of the Football League, 리버풀 are seven points clear of 스컨소프 유나이티드 at the top of the Second Division, South Coast clubs 본머스 & Boscombe Athletic and 포츠머스 lead Division Three, and Welsh club 렉섬 , who have recorded 14 wins already this season, are top of the Fourth Division.
